text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David the servant of the Lord , who addressed the words of this song to the Lord on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said:
text_cn: 交与乐官，上主的仆人达味作，达味在上主救他脱离一切仇敌，尤其撒乌耳的毒手时，向上主唱了这篇诗歌，

text_en: I love you, O Lord , my strength.
text_cn: 说： 上主，我的力量！我爱慕你。

text_en: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, my God, my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
text_cn: 上主，你是我的磐石、我的保障，我的避难所； 你是我的天主，我所一心依靠的磐石； 你是我的护盾，我救恩的角，我的堡垒。

text_en: I call upon the Lord , who is worthy to be praised, so I shall be saved from my enemies.
text_cn: 我一呼求应受颂扬的上主， 我便会从仇敌的手中得救。

text_en: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of perdition assailed me;
text_cn: 死亡的狂涛环围着我， 凶恶的险波惊吓着我，

text_en: the cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
text_cn: 阴府的绳缰缠绕着我， 丧命的罗网拘绊着我。

text_en: In my distress I called upon the Lord ; to my God I cried for help. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry to him reached his ears.
text_cn: 我在急难当中呼求了上主， 向我的天主求助； 他由殿中听我祷告，我的声音进入他的耳鼓。

text_en: Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations also of the mountains trembled and quaked, because he was angry.
text_cn: 因为上主愤怒填胸， 大地立即战栗震惊， 山基陵根摇撼移动。

text_en: Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.
text_cn: 由他的鼻孔涌出浓烟， 由他的口中喷出烈焰， 由他的身上射出火炭。

text_en: He bowed the heavens, and came down; thick darkness was under his feet.
text_cn: 他使诸天低垂，亲自降临， 在他的脚下面密布浓云。

text_en: He rode on a cherub, and flew; he came swiftly upon the wings of the wind.
text_cn: 他乘坐革鲁宾飞扬； 藉着风的翼羽翱翔。

text_en: He made darkness his covering around him, his canopy thick clouds dark with water.
text_cn: 他四周以黑暗作帷帐， 以含雨的浓云为屏障。

text_en: Out of the brightness before him there broke through his clouds hailstones and coals of fire.
text_cn: 闪电在他前辉煌， 红炭发出了火光。

text_en: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Most High uttered his voice.
text_cn: 上主由高天发出雷鸣， 至高者吼出他的呼声。

text_en: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; he flashed forth lightnings, and routed them.
text_cn: 他射出羽箭，将人驱散； 他发出闪电，使人逃窜。

text_en: Then the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, O Lord , at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
text_cn: 上主的呵斥一呼， 鼻孔的怒气一出， 沧海的海底出现， 大地的地基露绽。

text_en: He reached down from on high, he took me; he drew me out of mighty waters.
text_cn: 他由高处伸手将我拉住， 他由洪水之中将我提出；

text_en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
text_cn: 救我脱离了我的敌手， 摆脱了强于我的仇雠（chóu）。

text_en: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the Lord was my support.
text_cn: 他们在我困厄之日袭击我， 然而上主却作了我的城堡；

text_en: He brought me out into a broad place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text_cn: 他引领我步入广阔的平原， 他因喜爱我，而给了我救援。

text_en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he recompensed me.
text_cn: 上主照我的正义酬答了我， 按我双手的清白赏报了我；

text_en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord , and have not wickedly departed from my God.
text_cn: 因我遵行了上主的道路， 没有作恶背弃我的天主。

text_en: For all his ordinances were before me, and his statutes I did not put away from me.
text_cn: 他的一切法令常在我的眼前， 他的任何诫命我总没有弃捐；

text_en: I was blameless before him, and I kept myself from guilt.
text_cn: 我在他前常保持成全， 我自知防范各种罪愆（qiān）。

text_en: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.
text_cn: 因此，上主照我在他眼前的正道， 并照我双手的清白给了我赏报。

text_en: With the loyal you show yourself loyal; with the blameless you show yourself blameless;
text_cn: 仁慈的人，你待他仁慈； 正直的人，你待他正直；

text_en: with the pure you show yourself pure; and with the crooked you show yourself perverse.
text_cn: 纯洁的人，你待他纯洁； 乖戾（lì）的人，你待他乖戾。

text_en: For you deliver a humble people, but the haughty eyes you bring down.
text_cn: 卑微的人，你必要救起； 傲慢的人，你必要轻视。

text_en: It is you who light my lamp; the Lord , my God, lights up my darkness.
text_cn: 上主，是你使我的灯笼放光， 我主，是你把我的黑暗照亮。

text_en: By you I can crush a troop, and by my God I can leap over a wall.
text_cn: 仗着你的助佑，我冲上了战场； 靠着我的天主，我跳过了城墙。

text_en: This God—his way is perfect; the promise of the Lord proves true; he is a shield for all who take refuge in him.
text_cn: 天主的道路是完善的； 上主的言语是精炼的； 凡是投奔他的人， 他必作他的后盾。

text_en: For who is God except the Lord ? And who is a rock besides our God? —
text_cn: 除了上主以外，还有谁是天主？ 我们天主以外，还有谁是磐石？

text_en: the God who girded me with strength, and made my way safe.
text_cn: 是天主使我腰缠英武， 使我的道路平坦无阻；

text_en: He made my feet like the feet of a deer, and set me secure on the heights.
text_cn: 使我的双脚敏捷与鹿蹄相同， 使我能稳立于高山的危峰；

text_en: He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
text_cn: 是他教导我的手上阵进攻， 使我伸出臂膊开张了铜弓。

text_en: You have given me the shield of your salvation, and your right hand has supported me; your help has made me great.
text_cn: 你把救生的盾赐给了我， 你的右手不断扶持了我， 使我日渐强大因你爱我。

text_en: You gave me a wide place for my steps under me, and my feet did not slip.
text_cn: 你为我的脚步拓展了道路， 我的双脚总没有颠簸踌躇。

text_en: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; and did not turn back until they were consumed.
text_cn: 我追击我的仇敌，且把他们捕捉， 决不返回，直到将他们除尽灭绝。

text_en: I struck them down, so that they were not able to rise; they fell under my feet.
text_cn: 我将他们打得一败涂地， 叫他们在我的脚下倒毙。

text_en: For you girded me with strength for the battle; you made my assailants sink under me.
text_cn: 你使我腰缠英武奋勇作战， 叫敌对我的人都向我就范；

text_en: You made my enemies turn their backs to me, and those who hated me I destroyed.
text_cn: 使我的敌人在我前转背逃窜， 使我把一切仇恨我的人驱散。

text_en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them; they cried to the Lord , but he did not answer them.
text_cn: 他们呐喊，却没有人救援， 呼号上主，也得不到矜怜。

text_en: I beat them fine, like dust before the wind; I cast them out like the mire of the streets.
text_cn: 我粉碎他们像风吹的灰尘， 我践踏他们似道上的土粪。

text_en: You delivered me from strife with the peoples; you made me head of the nations; people whom I had not known served me.
text_cn: 你救我脱离了叛乱的人民， 又封立了我为列国的元勋， 我不认识的民族， 也都来给我服务。

text_en: As soon as they heard of me they obeyed me; foreigners came cringing to me.
text_cn: 外邦的子民向我谄媚奉承， 一听到是我，即刻向我服膺（yīng）。

text_en: Foreigners lost heart, and came trembling out of their strongholds.
text_cn: 外方的子民惊惶失色， 战战兢兢走出了堡垒。

text_en: The Lord lives! Blessed be my rock, and exalted be the God of my salvation,
text_cn: 上主万岁！愿我的磐石备受赞颂！ 救我的天主备受尊崇！

text_en: the God who gave me vengeance and subdued peoples under me;
text_cn: 天主，是你为我伸冤复仇， 求你使万民都向我屈服；

text_en: who delivered me from my enemies; indeed, you exalted me above my adversaries; you delivered me from the violent.
text_cn: 是你拯救我脱离了我的仇敌， 从凌驾我者的拳下把我提起， 救我免于向我施暴人的手里。

text_en: For this I will extol you, O Lord , among the nations, and sing praises to your name.
text_cn: 上主，为此，我要在异民中称谢你， 我要对你的圣名赞颂不已：

text_en: Great triumphs he gives to his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
text_cn: 因为是你使你的君王大获胜利， 对你的受傅者：达味和他的后裔， 广施了仁爱慈惠，至于无穷之世。
